name: dugout
title: Dugout
description: A football-club theme drawn from the pocket fixture card: sky-blue card stock, a claret band with one white stripe, and every date in one narrow card that opens at a fold into ruled rows, date over time and match over ground, with cancellations boxed.

tokens.--font-display: the condensed capitals: club name, menu, headings, dates, fixtures, names, the join link
tokens.--font-text: running text, times, places, roles and contact details
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of the small capitals: menu, founded line, statuses, tags, table heads
tokens.--color-bg: the sky-blue card stock of the page (navy at night) and the light half of the cover shield
tokens.--color-text: print on the ground and the card cover: name, menu, headlines, regular week, contact, heavy rules
tokens.--color-muted: quieter print on the ground: founded line, places, the rules of the regular week, page count
tokens.--color-accent: the thick link underline, the current menu mark, the open-to-all square, the quote bar
tokens.--color-cover: the cover leaf of the fixture card
tokens.--color-band: the claret band on the card cover and at its foot, the stub top, the join and skip links, the page's top edge
tokens.--color-stripe: the one white stripe across every claret band
tokens.--color-leaf: the white inner leaves: fixture rows, page text, news, people, the event stub
tokens.--color-leaf-ink: print on a leaf, the cancelled box and the members-only square
tokens.--color-leaf-muted: secondary print on a leaf: times, places, statuses, roles, news dates, past rows
tokens.--color-rule: ruled lines on a leaf: between fixtures, the column rule, people, news and table rows
tokens.--color-crease: the fold line between the card cover and its inner leaf
tokens.--color-fold: the shading either side of the fold
tokens.--color-focus: outer ring of the focus outline
tokens.--color-focus-ring: inner ring of the focus outline
tokens.--shadow-card: the edge and shadow under the card, leaves and stub
tokens.--measure-text: maximum line length of running text
tokens.--card-width: width of the fixture card and its column on wide screens
tokens.--when-width: width of the date-and-time column of the card
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of the card, leaves, stub and join link
tokens.--rule: weight of the heavy rules: under the masthead, above the club card, under headings and table heads
tokens.--underline: thickness of the claret link underline
tokens.--space-2: small gap inside labels and under headings
tokens.--space-3: page gutter on small screens and the card's inner margin
tokens.--space-5: large gap above the headline and at the page foot
